response.sql: WITH all_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_avgs AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as status_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying_statuses AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.status_avg, a.overall_avg, s.status_avg - a.overall_avg as above_average FROM status_avgs s CROSS JOIN all_avg a WHERE s.status_avg > a.overall_avg), mean_of_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying_avgs FROM qualifying_statuses) SELECT q.rfistat, q.status_avg, q.above_average, q.status_avg - m.mean_of_qualifying_avgs as differs_from_mean FROM qualifying_statuses q CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying m ORDER BY q.status_avg DESC
